name: Technical review record — entrance/exit criteria and action items
systemOfRecord: Contract-designated technical-review presentation package and meeting-minutes records
This feed preserves received authoritative record content and source provenance. It does not declare review approval, conduct a technical review, or replace the source records.

Applicable NAVAIR SETR checklist and documented program-specific SEP/checklist tailoring under the supplied NAVAIRINST4355.19E issue; actual current applicability is verified for the receiving program, not inferred from a bare citation.

Actual government-application compatibility and contractual acceptance must be verified before production acceptance. formats.format: Chosen UTF-8 JSON representation of applicable NAVAIR checklist criteria, assessment and tailoring context
formats.spec: NAVAIRINST4355.19E §§4b(7),5c,5e,5f and Enclosure(2) supply the content/assessment basis. This chosen representation is not a native government schema; the actual checklist/tool and RFA form were not inspected. The provided issue allows records across media/formats under §7.

cadence: Contract/CDRL-defined review and meeting delivery timing. Neither inspected DID establishes a fixed reporting interval, a fixed number of days before or after review, or a maximum action age. The suspense date is an action field, not a universal feed cadence. Inspection scope: DI-SESS-82168 §§1-3.11 (https://quicksearch.dla.mil/WMX/Default.aspx?token=5749157) and DI-ADMN-81250C §§1-3.2 (https://quicksearch.dla.mil/WMX/Default.aspx?token=5773622); the action suspense date is specified at §3(f) of the latter. For NAVAIR context, §5f says the final assessment is provided to the TRB Chair, TRB members and designated competency representatives prior to review; this nonmodal timing fact is not a newly extracted shall or a numerical delivery deadline. Source: https://www.dau.edu/sites/default/files/Migrated/CopDocuments/NAVAIRINST%204355.19E%20SE%20Technical%20Review%20Process%2020150206.pdf

fields.description: Named review section or the actual technical-review meeting context; preserve the requested scope and distinguish HCDR from other CDR uses. fields.name: criterionText
fields.description: Actual entrance or exit criterion content for the applicable event, milestone or task. No universal pass/fail threshold, score, achieved maturity, or approval is inferred. Required when: When the invoked review section requires entrance or exit criteria. For conditional source fields, required=false means not universally mandatory across every row type; the applicable source rule remains mandatory when its condition holds. For instruction-based entries, preserve the full effective native criterion, all compound/nested conditions, state and timing qualifiers, plus its source and approved tailoring. A record locator alone does not preserve criterion content. NAVAIR Enclosure (2) provides entry criteria; the original criterion is not silently rewritten or promoted into an execution order. Within the TRPP product matrix, entrance/exit-criteria products are explicitly listed only for SRR, SFR, PDR, HCDR and PRR. The Content Definitions catalogue does not add such a product to ASR, SSR, TRR, FCA or PCA. This TRPP product applicability is distinct from the separately scoped NAVAIR Enclosure (2) entry criteria. Rev2 removes repeated governing prose only from the criterion source quotation. Complete criterion words and nested conditions remain in this operative field; the parent duty is traced separately.
